data.text:
#BTS makes history as 'Permission to Dance - On Stage Live' becomes the 1st live album by an Asian Act  to debut at #1 on the Worldwide & European iTunes Album Charts! It breaks the record for the best-selling live album in Hanteo history (326K units)! 💪🏆🥇🔞💿🎤🎶✖️🌏👨‍🎤💥1⃣🌎&🌍🎵➕🏆🔝💰🔞💿🎤🇰🇷🐐👑💜
'Permission to Dance - On Stage Live' has reached #1 on iTunes in 44+ countries so far, and lifts to a new peak at #5 (+1) on US iTunes! It scores the Top New Entry on the Worldwide & European Apple Music Album charts, debuting at #11 & #15 respectively, after reaching #1 on Apple Music in multiple countries!

The lead single, "Permission To Dance", debuts at #1 on the Worldwide iTunes song chart, at #2 on European iTunes and has now lifted to a new peak at #16 (+3) on US iTunes after reaching #1 in 36+ countries so far! All 22 tracks from the album have debuted inside the Top 40 of Worldwide iTunes and the Top 60 of European iTunes! All 22 songs have also debuted on US iTunes, with BTS breaking the record as the foreign Act with the most singles debuting simultaneously on the US chart! 

All 22 tracks from 'Permission To Dance Live' have debuted on the Armenian iTunes Song Chart claiming every spot from #1 to #22!!

BTS rockets to #3 on the Global Digital Artist Rank (+112)!
